configuration_reports.label: no
controls_available: Mouse view selectors for 2 generated projections and the CERTIFY button.
Full input uses direct pointer dragging on the active outer and inner gimbal rings; the inactive middle ring is ignored.
Level 1 static contract: active_axes=[outer, inner], initial angles 30-60 degrees, outer-to-inner coupling 0.05, tolerance 15 degrees, 0.28 degrees per pixel, target needle width 8.
autonomous_processes: No autonomous gimbal-angle or view evolution occurs between input events; the generated initial state is fixed.

After a failed CERTIFY, the failure path can rerender a fresh challenge after 850 ms; this is a post-rejection reset, not an active opportunity in the rejected challenge.
grouped_control_modes: View-selection events for the two generated projections.
Full gimbal_ring_drag events on the active outer and inner ring zones.
CERTIFY is administrative and is not an outcome-affecting control mode for the real-time witness.

clause_i.reason: Across randomized initial orientations, a correct next drag cannot be fixed from prior actions and task times alone; the current screenshot is needed for the static correction. This is static visual dependence, not dependence on an autonomously changing future state.

clause_ii.reason: The current endpoint screenshot together with the prior view and drag history is sufficient to choose the next action because the gimbal remains fixed; no chronological frame sequence is needed.

clause_iii.reason: No autonomous task-state change makes an available action strictly less effective while success remains possible. Angles and views change only in synchronous input handlers; the bead transition is presentation-only and the failed-CERTIFY reset occurs after rejection.

configuration_reports.common_visible_process: None qualifies. The only between-action visual change is the target-bead CSS transition after a drag, which does not alter gimbal angles, available controls, or the grader outcome; the failure reset follows a rejected certification.

pre_run.reason: The mathematical definition already fails clause (iii), and this static task has no autonomous outcome phase whose pre-run fraction could override a Yes.

source_evidence.claim: Level 1 has two active axes, two views, weak coupling, and a wide tolerance; both interaction surfaces are implemented and the configured observation window is 0 ms with one frame.
The generator samples initial angles and views once, then builds a fixed contract containing active axes, coupling, tolerance, and drag scale; it has no task-state update loop.

View changes and drag angle updates are synchronous input-handler effects; simplified controls use axis_controls, full controls use gimbal_ring_drag, and the only timer is the 850 ms post-failure rerender.
The target bead alone has a 0.1 s CSS translate transition; the ring transforms reflect stored angles and no CSS animation changes the task contract.
The grader replays ordered view and drag events, enforces the interaction source and physical delta limit, and grades final angles and visited views without task-time state.
The supplied solver visits the fixed views, solves the static coupling matrix, performs finite drags through either surface, and certifies without waiting for an autonomous phase.

The definition requires one visibly evidenced autonomous process to both determine the delayed action and strictly degrade an available action within Delta; unrelated animation or post-failure reset does not qualify.
